name: new-account
about: The suite's setup continues without an account; this walk makes one from the joined key (qa-<walk_tag>). Chat and huddle include it as a prelude, so it runs once per rig, just before the first of them and after chat-no-account (which needs no account to exist yet): name no suite file so it sorts before chat-no-account.json and includes this. Making the account is a user-signed create; the passkey half after it waits on a phone this walk does not have, so the walk cancels it there. Starts from an open console and leaves it open.

params.walk_tag: a short tag unique to this walk, e.g. the merge's short sha: it names what the walk makes so a later run can find it

steps.say: press the rail's account button, Account: Sign in
steps.expect: the account screen shows: a Your account heading, an Account name field, and Create account, Sign in, Use this device, Continue without account and Cancel buttons

steps.say: type the account name into the Account name field
steps.expect: the Account name field's value is qa-{param:walk_tag} and Create account is enabled (its state does not list disabled)

the passkey step is shown: an Account QR code image and the line 'Scan 1 of 2 — your phone creates the passkey.' are on screen (a time-left line is fine; the Account name field and the Create account, Sign in and Continue without account buttons stay on the same screen beneath the QR code — that is expected, not a failure); no error sentence. A line that refuses the account is a finding: quote it

steps.say: press Cancel to stop the passkey scan (the account is already made; this walk has no phone)
steps.expect: the Account QR code and the Scan 1 of 2 line are gone; the Your account screen still shows, with no error sentence

steps.say: press Cancel to go back to the console
steps.expect: the console shows again with its rail; the rail's account button reads Account: qa-{param:walk_tag} (or Account #<number>), not Account: Sign in, and there is no 'Sign in to use your account on this network.' banner
